text: Confronted by those words, I feel a tremor of uncertainty and curiosity ripple through me. The sterile glass and empty corridor unsettle me, as though I have stumbled into a space where I do not yet belong. Moving to the next room, the bold, abstract visuals and the words 'R+D' spark a sense of wonder, but also dislocation. Am I a visitor, an intruder, or perhaps a participant in the experiment of existence? Here, my presence feels questioned, and so I turn inward, pondering the nature of identity amid unfamiliar territory.
